sections.Profile:
"Gun Smoke" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in 1968. The game features a Western theme, incorporating two flippers, three pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, and a center up-post referred to as the "Ball Saver."

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Original Theme, Guns
